q: What is the cheapest reliable groundedness check?
options: Verifying that each quoted span exists in the cited source
explain: Exact-quote checks cost almost nothing and catch fabricated quotes.

q: Why give the model permission to say “the sources don’t say”?
options: Without it, the model fills gaps from memory

q: What makes a citation useful to a user?
options: A link to the specific passage or page, ideally with a quote
explain: Users should verify in seconds, not search a whole file.
